title: Clamp Factory
statement: Implement `solve(low, high, values)`. The bounds are closed over by a clamp function. Return the clamped `values`. If `low` is greater than `high`, return the string `error` and do not clamp. Each value below `low` becomes `low`, each value above `high` becomes `high`, and interior values stay.
constraints: values is a list of integers
hints: Check the bounds once, before the loop.
The inner function reads low and high from the enclosing scope.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A factory returns a function that already knows its bounds, which is what you want when the same clamp is applied to a stream.

editorial: A factory returns a function that already knows its bounds, which is what you want when the same clamp is applied to a stream. Checking the bounds once avoids repeating a configuration error on every value. The map over values is the call list.
